## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.11`

### Features

- have the crab knock in the SSH sign-in prompt and when a host's key is new: the connection waits at the door for the user's answer, so the crab takes the key icon's place beside the prompt's title and stands beside the unknown host key's title, knocking afresh for each host when tunnels queue several; a host whose key changed gets no crab, since a changed key may be an attack and the warning should not look playful ([de3fcb89](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/de3fcb891fac99b2381c65460d3a83e8993ac6f3))
- offer the crab as a style of the AI agent badge on a tab: "Crab pinching" while the agent works and "Crab knocking" while it waits for the user, in Settings > Appearance next to the other styles; the badge draws the small crab 18 px tall, the smallest at which its eyes and claws still read at 100% scaling, and the knock plays three times like the ripple of the other waiting marks, since an agent may wait for hours; picked for working, the crab becomes every loading spinner too, as the other working styles do; it keeps its own colors, so the settings say so instead of offering a color; a Crab component builds the layers from src/assets/crab and picks the small drawing below 32 px ([8ed4a284](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/8ed4a284f96180989516994ab9270006bdfe8891))
- show the crab pinching its claws on the splash screen while tTerm loads: the front-facing crab, a terminal window for a body with two eyes on top and a claw at each side, is drawn in scripts/app-icon/crab.mjs and written by pnpm icons:update to src/assets/crab as one SVG per moving part (the jaws, the arm, the eyes, the impact marks), plus a small version on an 18 px grid for badges; crab.css stacks the parts and animates each as its own HTML box rather than inside the SVG, since Chromium runs both on the compositor but WebKit, the webview on macOS and Linux, is only sure to do so for HTML boxes, and it already holds the knock that later asks for the user's attention; the splash drops the pulsing mascot.png, which stays for the README ([750d1a95](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/750d1a95c878eb2b9ad8caeed494571286919f64))

### Fixes

- rebuild the app when its icons change: tauri-build compiles icons/icon.ico into the Windows resource the taskbar and window icons come from, and generate_context! embeds the icons on other platforms, but neither tells Cargo to watch them, so after pnpm icons:update the app kept showing its old icon until a clean build; build.rs now asks Cargo to rerun when the icons directory changes ([443ea3fa](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/443ea3fab1591590babfa18899489fdad514e8e6))

### UI and usability

- split the app icon into a logo and a mascot so the icon reads on a taskbar: the hermit crab carrying a terminal window blurred into texture at the 24 px of the Windows taskbar, where the icons that stay readable are one or two solid shapes on a tile, so the app icon is now a dark > prompt beside a red crab on the mascot's beach tile, reaching the canvas edges on Windows and Linux and inside Apple's margin on macOS, with each claw in its own group so it can be animated later; the crab sticker keeps its place as the mascot in mascot.svg and mascot.png for the README, the splash screen and the About dialog, and since one drawing now serves every size the .ico merge in ico.mjs is gone ([60e183fd](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/60e183fd52e16a1638db62d562c7a900899bbdbc))
- redraw the app icon for 48 px and below so it reads on the Windows taskbar: the crab and window covered half the tile and the sticker border, shadow and rough lines blurred into grey, and Windows also scales the 48 px entry down for the taskbar at 125% and 150% scaling; the small drawing now keeps the tile but drops the sun, sand, filter, legs and face, uses straight lines that land on pixels, fills the tile with the window and crab with the eyes over the dark screen, and covers the .ico entries up to 48 px and the 44 px Store logo ([f3e83649](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f3e8364992ec5c092fa21c5a0dca5843578a8fca))

### Other changes

- rename the crab working style from "Crab pinching" to "Crab waving" (螃蟹捏钳子 to 螃蟹挥钳子): the badge and spinners draw the small crab, whose claws swing as a whole since its jaws are too small to read opening and closing, so the old name promised a motion the setting never shows ([004074cd](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/004074cdbf6ff186b78ffc0bf58f82fb6b6b25ae))
